title: v0.1.1 — first public Babel Desktop download (unsigned preview)
summary: First release with downloadable artifacts: the Windows portable bundle (Desktop shell + bundled CLI + pinned Node runtime), its SHA256SUMS and file manifest, and the babel-harness CLI package tarball. The bundle is an unsigned preview.

title: v0.1.0 — first public pre-1.0 source release
summary: First public source tag of Babel. The release tag carries no downloadable assets; install remains clone + build.

title: Windows runtime and first-launch packaging merged (PR #306)
summary: Desktop packaging work landed on main. This is a source milestone only: no public Desktop download or installer qualification exists yet.
